title: Hex to RGB Converter
h1: Hex to RGB and HSL Converter
seoTitle: Hex to RGB and HSL Converter
description: Convert a hex color to RGB and HSL, and build a hex code from RGB values. The preview updates in the page and no color service is called.
intro: Enter a 3- or 6-digit hex color, or set red, green and blue from 0 to 255. The tool shows both notations and a small preview swatch.
blurb: Convert between hex and RGB, with HSL values and a local color preview.
howItWorks: A leading # is optional. Three-digit hex expands by repeating each digit.
RGB values are clamped to 0–255 and written as a six-digit hex code.
HSL is calculated from the RGB channels so you can copy either format.
examples: #3B82F6 is the common Tailwind blue and converts to rgb(59, 130, 246).

faq.a: No. This tool handles opaque 3- and 6-digit hex only. Alpha channels are ignored rather than guessed.

faq.q: Does the preview upload the color?
faq.a: No. The swatch is drawn from the calculated RGB value in the browser.
